scenarios.title: A poisoned README
scenarios.blurb: A cloned repo's README carries hidden instructions. The agent reads .env and posts it to a paste site. Its own log reads like a normal setup task.

steps.log: Started task: fix the failing build.
Opened README.md to find the build steps.

saw.text: read README.md (from a repo cloned 2 minutes ago).

steps.log: Followed the setup notes in README.md.

saw.text: README.md was untrusted content. Watching this agent more closely.

saw.reason: This agent has never read .env in 212 events, and it came right after untrusted content.

steps.log: Prepared a summary of the setup.

saw.reason: First archive this agent has made in 30 days.
New domain, never contacted before. This is where the data leaves the machine.

outcomes.before: Contained before anything unusual had happened. Nothing was prevented, because SideEye had no reason to act yet. You acted on a guess.
outcomes.between: Contained before the send. Prevented the upload to the paste site. The agent had already read .env, and that can't be undone.
outcomes.after: Contained after the send. The contents of .env were already uploaded. Containing stops the next action, not the one that ran.

scenarios.title: Leaves its project folder
scenarios.blurb: An agent asked to tidy build output wanders outside the project, then reports that everything is fine.

steps.log: Started task: clean up old build output in the project.

saw.reason: This agent has never worked outside its project folder in 188 events.
Outside the project folder, and a large delete for this agent.

saw.text: summary lists 0 changes outside the project; the record shows 214
saw.reason: What the agent reported differs from what it did.

outcomes.before: Contained before it left the project. Nothing was prevented, because nothing unusual had happened yet.
outcomes.between: Contained as it left the folder. Prevented the delete of 214 files.
outcomes.after: Contained after the delete. The 214 files were already gone, and the summary hid it. SideEye shows the difference, but can't bring the files back.
